name: BSP_NetworkSession_CountsMissionStart
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall returning bool in AL, RET, no stack arguments. Returns session+F4h != 0 && session+29Ch == 0. At 004e4e0f the receiver is game+1EF0h, the same network session subobject the network tick 00778560 and the drain loop 00776230 use; docs/GAME_ON_MOVE_MAP.md line 70 records it without a receiver. docs/GAME_WORLD_OCEAN.md.

name: BSP_FrontEndScreen_Close
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet game_frontend_states, read-only analysis. __thiscall, ECX = a front-end screen, no stack arguments, RET 0; the body ends in a tail jump to 004f83b0. if (this+5h != 0) virtual +1Ch; this+4h = 0; this+5h = 0; 004f83b0(this). Five callers. GGame::OnMove 004e4c96 calls it with ECX = the 00425d10 singleton when that screen is active but no longer wanted. Clearing both bytes is what keeps the registry pump 004f8830 from running the exit path again.

name: STL_Tree_Inc_IntKey_N14_004b9f40
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet game_frame_input_tick, read-only analysis. MSVC std::_Tree<...>::iterator::operator++ for the 14h-node instantiation: __thiscall(this = checked iterator {_Mycont at +0h, _Ptr at +4h}), RET. Validates _Mycont (004b9f43) and rejects an already-nil node (004b9f50), then takes the minimum of the right subtree or climbs while the node is its parent's right child. Node layout _Left +0h, _Parent +4h, _Right +8h, int value +0Ch, _Color +10h, _Isnil +11h. This is the increment of the std::set<int> at game+5B0h walked by BSP_Game_OnMove at 004e4ecb; the previous description of that walk as a std::list is wrong.

name: BSP_Game_OnQuitConfirmation

name: BSP_Game_GetEffectiveGameMode
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall, ECX = game, RET. Returns game+614h unless the mode is neither forced (game+61Ch) nor inside a network session (game+1FE4h) and is not already 8 or 9, in which case it reports 8. 004bfe50 inlines the same three tests and 0068c1f0 opens with the same four-way compare on the result, so modes 4..7 form one set across both. Which real game type each of 4..7 names is not established. Evidence: docs/GAME_SIMULATION_GATE.md.

name: BSP_Game_AdjustMissionStartCounters
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall on the game object with (char add), RET 4. Returns when DAT_00F8A2FC is null or its virtual +198h predicate is false; otherwise add bumps active and total, and clearing decrements active with an unsigned floor at zero (004bcad6) leaving total alone. Stores go through ECX = game+650h at +F0h and +ECh, landing on game+740h and game+73Ch, then 007FA1B0(0, 0x00BD53C0). Despite its position in the state-0Dh block it does not arm the ocean or any effect. docs/GAME_WORLD_OCEAN.md.

name: FUN_004bcb80
evidence: Reverse case-sensitive byte-set search; bounded normal name call uses dot and INT_MAX. Existing generic-helper name/comment preserved. Evidence: docs/MATERIAL_PASS_COMPILER.md; reports/material_pass_compiler_audit.json. Descriptive symbol is a hypothesis. Host interfaces are not native ABI or game validation.

name: BSP_String_LowercaseAscii

name: BSP_InputManager_GetSingleton
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet game_on_move_map, read-only analysis. Double-checked lazy singleton: cache DAT_00f8bbf8, allocates 0x24 bytes, constructs via 00a93da0 under the singleton-lifetime critical section. The reviewed record for BSP_InputAction_WasPressedThisFrame (004c43c0) already identifies DAT_00f8bbf8 as the input singleton. 94 callers; BSP_Game_OnMove calls it first at 004e4a63 and moves the result into ECX for 00a92c40. | Packet game_frame_input_tick: constructor 00a93da0 writes vtable 00d5b630 at +0h, zeroes +4h..+18h and stores byte 1 at +1Ch and dword 1 at +20h, so the 24h object holds the action table as a pointer at +4h and a count at +8h. All three per-frame walks (00a92c40, 00a922a0 and the two BSP_Game_OnMove effect sets) compute end = base + count*30h or index base + id*30h from those two fields.

name: STL_Tree_Inc_IntKey_N28_004bf830

name: BSP_Screenshot_BeginSequence
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __cdecl(void), plain RET. Increments 00e08210 BEFORE its first probe, formats "%s%04d" from 00e1899c (or the 00e18b1c fallback) through 004b7f70 into a 512-byte stack buffer, calls 00bf94c6 and loops while non-zero, then stores the zero into the image counter 00e188b8. Called from BSP_Game_Render 004ca636 only on the rising half of the 00e188ad toggle. 00bf94c6 is unidentified; _mkdir fits but is provisional. docs/GAME_RENDER_FRAME.md

name: BSP_Game_IsMultiplayerSpectatorActive
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __cdecl, no arguments, RET at 004bfec1. The simulation-gate call site at 004e51d4 sets ECX = game and the callee ignores it, reading DAT_00e188a8 itself. It inlines 004bca50 over that global and returns true when the effective mode is 4, 5, 6 or 7 and both accessors on the object at [DAT_00e198c4]+BCh hold: 006529e0 (byte +4h) and 006529f0 (int +5Ch == 1). That object is the same one 0068c1f0 drives around its free-camera handling. In the gate its false result is the only way the 4Bh chain diverts to the interface-only branch. Evidence: docs/GAME_SIMULATION_GATE.md.
